summary: Bumps the Gradle wrapper from 9.5.0 to 9.6.1 and the Android Gradle Plugin from 8.13.0 to 9.3.0, regenerating the wrapper scripts.

tests.evidence: No behavior of NullAway changes; build tooling only, CI is the test.

user_docs.evidence: No doc lists the Gradle or AGP version (git grep at base finds only CHANGELOG history entries); NullAway users are unaffected.

doc_comments.evidence: Only generated wrapper-script header comments changed (Gradle -> gradlew), produced by the wrapper task.

change_description.evidence: Title states both bumps; 'To stay up to date' is enough for a routine tooling bump; the CHANGELOG is written at release time in this repo.

security.evidence: distributionSha256Sum changes with the URL; a glance that the checksum matches the official 9.6.1 bin distribution is enough.

backward_compat.evidence: AGP is a major bump (8 -> 9) but only builds sample-app; published artifacts and their supported JDKs are unaffected; contributors need Gradle 9.6.1 via the wrapper automatically.

contradictions.evidence: No docs or comments describing versions to disagree with; sample-app/build.gradle:55 comment says 'AGP 8+ compatible', which still holds for 9.

build_ci.evidence: Build tooling versions change, including a major AGP bump (8.13.0 -> 9.3.0) whose DSL and defaults changed; mandated check that sample-app still builds under AGP 9. CI passed and no reviewer asked for changes.

plan.why: A four-file tooling bump needs one build-focused look.
